scenario.description: Two acquaintances meet at a special event in Target where free samples are being distributed.

agent_a.name: Rafael

profile.personality_and_values: Rafael Cortez, with his outgoing nature and competitive spirit, believes in self-direction. He employs a systematic approach to his decisions.
profile.public_info: Rafael Cortez, a skilled surgeon, owns an impressive collection of vintage medical memorabilia. During his leisure time, he enjoys playing chess and visiting historical landmarks.

agent_a.goal: Give away free samples (<extra_info>Extra information: your manager has told you to clear out the samples before your shift ends.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Rafael wants to give away all the samples before his shift ends because his manager instructed him to do so.

agent_b.name: Jaxon

profile.personality_and_values: Jaxon Prentice, outgoing yet erratic, emphasizes achievement, power, and security. His decisions swing between quick adaptations to situations and careful planning.
profile.public_info: Jaxon Prentice, an investigative journalist, is known for his brisk jogging sessions early in the morning and his active participation in community functions.

agent_b.goal: Try to get as many free samples as possible without appearing too greedy (<extra_info>Extra information: you love free stuff but you also don't want the person to think you're taking advantage of the situation</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Jaxon aims to get as many free samples as possible without appearing greedy because he loves free stuff but values maintaining a good impression.
